title: Can someone create an edit of the RMXP rtp gargoyle?

posts.author: Supergenio
posts.body:
Hey everyone,
I'm working on a project in RPG Maker XP and I'm in need of a sprite edit for a gargoyle character. Specifically, I'm looking for someone who can create a gargoyle pose sprite and if its not too much to ask a frame from crouch to standing to match the RTP style of the game.
The gargoyle pose I have in mind is the classic one, like the sculptures you see on old buildings.
I need only the front looking standard frame, no need for the full animation.
Thanks in advance for any help or suggestions!
Best regards,

posts.author: hiddenone
posts.body:
@Supergenio
Looks like that's not one of XP's default sprites, did you make it? If you didn't please link where you found it, since we'll need to make sure the creator is fine with edits.
